correctness.rationale: The publisher source actually prints psi=u*g(psi) and P(X=0)=psi(0)=g(0). Evaluating u=0 forces psi(0)=0; Lagrange inversion gives p_n=1/n [z^(n-1)]g(z)^n for n>=1. g is a nondegenerate offspring PGF with mean m=(1-c)*gamma*theta/(1-theta). The sum of p_n is the smallest fixed point q=g(q), hence one for m<=1 and q<1 for m>1; the latter has missing mass at infinity and a conditioned finite-progeny law p_n/q. At paper simulation gamma=1.5, theta=.4, c=.3, m=.7 and g(0)=.625330601..., so adding the asserted zero mass yields 1.625330601..., whereas positive coefficients already have total one. This does not determine the simulations implementation.
residual_risks: Supercritical finite-valued law needs explicit conditioning. Paper simulations may normalize truncated weights rather than use literal proposed PMF.
